ios.desc:
The quickest way to save tagged notes to Notion.

Quick: it only takes seconds to write and tag a note. Add a Lock Screen widget to start writing even faster.
Secure: use the official Notion authorisation method, without generating your tokens manually. Your data is transmitted directly to Notion.
Offline: notes saved without internet connection will be sent later.

Get the "Instant Notion Pro" subscription to use additional features:

Home Screen Widgets: create widgets with your tags and start creating notes even faster
Create tags in the app: add new tags without opening Notion
Multiple databases: quickly switch between all of the shared databases
Saved notes: view all of the saved notes - also offline. You can copy each note or open it in Notion
